    • Method Detail

      • onInitialize

        void onInitialize()
        Called after the backend is constructed to perform any additional initialization, such as mapping exception vector tables (hypervisor) or setting up initial CPU state.

      • switchUserMode

        void switchUserMode()
        Switches the CPU to user mode (EL0/USR). On AArch32 this updates the CPSR mode bits; on AArch64 backends this is typically a no-op since only user-mode emulation is supported.

      • enableVFP

        void enableVFP()
        Enables the VFP (Vector Floating-Point) and Advanced SIMD (NEON) coprocessor. On AArch64 this sets the FPEN bits in CPACR_EL1; on AArch32 this configures C1_C0_2 and FPEXC registers.

      • reg_read

        Number reg_read(int regId)
         throws BackendException
        Reads the value of a CPU register.
        Parameters:
        regId - register ID, typically from unicorn.ArmConst or unicorn.Arm64Const
        Returns:
        the register value as a Number (Integer for 32-bit, Long for 64-bit)
        Throws:
        BackendException - if the register read fails

      • reg_read_vector

        Returns:

      • mem_map

        void mem_map(long address,
             long size,
             int perms)
      throws BackendException
        Maps a region of emulated memory. The address and size must be page-aligned. The backing host memory is allocated lazily via mmap(MAP_ANONYMOUS).
        Parameters:
        address - page-aligned starting guest virtual address
        size - page-aligned size in bytes
        perms - permissions bitmask (combination of UC_PROT_READ, UC_PROT_WRITE, UC_PROT_EXEC)
        Throws:
        BackendException - if alignment is invalid or mapping fails

      • mem_protect

        void mem_protect(long address,
                 long size,
                 int perms)
          throws BackendException
        Changes the access permissions of an existing memory mapping.
        Parameters:
        address - page-aligned starting guest virtual address
        size - page-aligned size in bytes
        perms - new permissions bitmask
        Throws:
        BackendException - if the region is not mapped or operation fails

      • mem_unmap

        Parameters:

        Throws:
        BackendException - if the region is not mapped or unmapping fails

      • addBreakPoint

        BreakPoint addBreakPoint(long address,
                         BreakPointCallback callback,
                         boolean thumb)
        Adds a software breakpoint at the given address.
        Parameters:
        address - guest virtual address to break on
        callback - optional callback invoked when the breakpoint is hit, may be null
        thumb - true if the breakpoint targets a Thumb instruction (AArch32 only)
        Returns:
        a BreakPoint handle that can be used to query or modify the breakpoint

      • removeBreakPoint

        boolean removeBreakPoint(long address)
        Removes a previously added breakpoint.
        Parameters:
        address - guest virtual address of the breakpoint to remove
        Returns:
        true if the breakpoint was found and removed

      • setSingleStep

        void setSingleStep(int singleStep)
        Configures single-step execution. After calling this, the emulator will break after executing the specified number of instructions.
        Parameters:
        singleStep - number of instructions to execute before breaking; 0 to disable

      • setFastDebug

        void setFastDebug(boolean fastDebug)
        Toggles fast debug mode. When enabled, the debugger hook skips per-instruction callbacks and only breaks on breakpoints or single-step events, improving performance.
        Parameters:
        fastDebug - true to enable fast debug mode

      • removeJitCodeCache

        void removeJitCodeCache(long begin,
                        long end)
                 throws BackendException
        Invalidates the JIT code cache for the specified address range. Should be called after modifying code in mapped memory to ensure the backend re-translates the affected region.
        Parameters:
        begin - start address of the range (inclusive)
        end - end address of the range (exclusive)
        Throws:
        BackendException - if the operation fails

      • getCpuFeatures

        Map<String,Integer> getCpuFeatures()
        Returns the CPU feature flags supported by the backend.

        arm64_features hw.optional.floatingpoint hw.optional.AdvSIMD hw.optional.arm.AdvSIMD hw.optional.arm.FEAT_AES hw.optional.arm.FEAT_PMULL hw.optional.arm.FEAT_SHA1 hw.optional.arm.FEAT_SHA256 hw.optional.armv8_crc32 hw.optional.arm.FEAT_LSE hw.optional.arm.FEAT_FP16 hw.optional.arm.AdvSIMD_HPFPCvt hw.optional.arm.FEAT_RDM hw.optional.arm.FEAT_JSCVT hw.optional.arm.FEAT_FCMA hw.optional.arm.FEAT_LRCPC hw.optional.arm.FEAT_DPB hw.optional.arm.FEAT_SHA3 hw.optional.arm.FEAT_DotProd hw.optional.arm.FEAT_SHA512 hw.optional.arm.FEAT_FHM hw.optional.arm.FEAT_DIT hw.optional.arm.FEAT_LSE2 hw.optional.arm.FEAT_FlagM hw.optional.arm.FEAT_SSBS hw.optional.arm.FEAT_SB hw.optional.arm.FEAT_FlagM2 hw.optional.arm.FEAT_FRINTTS hw.optional.arm.FEAT_I8MM hw.optional.arm.FEAT_BF16 hw.optional.arm.FEAT_BTI

        Returns:
        a map of feature name to value (1 if supported, 0 otherwise)

      • getMemAllocatedSize

        long getMemAllocatedSize()
        Returns the total virtual memory size allocated via mem_map(long, long, int).

        This is the sum of all mapped pages tracked by the backend's native memory hash table. For unicorn2, this is computed from uc_mem_regions().

        Returns:
        total allocated memory in bytes

      • getMemResidentSize

        long getMemResidentSize()
        Returns the actual physical memory resident in RAM.

        On macOS/Linux, this uses mincore() to check which pages are actually backed by physical memory, since mmap(MAP_ANONYMOUS) allocates lazily. Only pages that have been read from or written to will be counted.

        On Windows (dynarmic) and unicorn2 (QEMU-based), host memory pointers are not accessible, so this returns the same value as getMemAllocatedSize().

        Returns:
        resident memory in bytes

      • isHypervisor

        default boolean isHypervisor()
        Returns whether this backend runs on Apple's Hypervisor.framework. Hypervisor backends have hardware-accelerated execution but certain limitations (e.g., only one VM instance per process, AArch64 only).
        Returns:
        true if this is a hypervisor backend
